title: Failure paths print errors but still complete successfully
reasoning: Several management-command failure cases only write styled error text and then return normally. Django management commands that fail validation or detect unsuccessful work should raise CommandError so callers receive a non-zero exit status. As written, scripts and CI jobs can treat missing feast IDs, missing required options, or failed waited map generation as successful executions.
recommendation: Raise CommandError for invalid regenerate_feast_contexts usage, nonexistent feast IDs, and failed waited map generation instead of only writing to stdout.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are listed, and there is no evidence that command exit status is asserted for these error paths.
suggestedRegressionTest: Use call_command for each invalid/failure case and assert CommandError is raised, or invoke the command runner and assert a non-zero exit status.
minimumFixScope: Update the shown error branches to raise django.core.management.base.CommandError and add focused command tests for failure status.
